ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $EG \parallel BC$, if $\frac{EG}{BC} = \frac{1}{3}$, then what is the value of $\frac{AF}{AD}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $EG \parallel BC$,\\
thus $\triangle AEG \sim \triangle ABC$,\\
so $\frac{AE}{AB}=\frac{EG}{BC}=\frac{1}{3}$,\\
Given $EG \parallel BC$,\\
thus $\triangle AEF \sim \triangle ABD$,\\
so $\frac{AF}{AD}=\frac{AE}{AB}=\boxed{\frac{1}{3}}$.
